status: synthetic placeholders pending Epic Cure guidance (guideline sources cited per rule; numbers not clinically signed off)

Low Sugar.source: ADA Standards of Care (nutrition therapy for diabetes) and AHA added-sugar limit (25 g/day women, 36 g/day men). Per-serving cut-offs are placeholders: capped is about 1/4 and restricted about 1/2 of a 50 g daily sugar budget. Total sugars are used, so this is stricter than the added-sugar guidance.

Low Sodium.source: AHA/DASH: under 2,300 mg/day, ideal 1,500 mg/day. Capped above 480 mg is about 20% of 2,300 mg (FDA 'high' is 20% DV or more); restricted above 960 mg is about 40%.

Heart Healthy.source: AHA/DASH: saturated fat under 6% of calories, about 13 g/day at 2,000 kcal. Capped above 4 g is about 30% of that; restricted above 8 g is about 60% (FDA 'high' is 20% DV or more, 4 g).

Kidney Friendly.source: NKF/KDOQI 2020 CKD nutrition guideline: potassium is individualised (typically 2,000-3,000 mg/day when serum potassium is high); NKF lists under 200 mg/serving as low potassium. Capped above 300 mg and restricted above 600 mg are looser pantry cut-offs.

Vegetarian.source: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics position on vegetarian diets: no meat, poultry, fish or shellfish.

Vegan.source: Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics position on vegetarian diets: no animal products (adds egg and dairy to the vegetarian exclusions).

Gluten Free.source: ACG celiac disease guideline / NIDDK: avoid wheat, barley and rye.

Nut Allergy.source: NIAID food allergy guidelines and FDA major food allergens: strict avoidance of peanut and tree nut.

Dairy Free.source: NIAID food allergy guidelines and FDA major food allergens: strict avoidance of milk.
